title: PWR-A SHRINK-2 placement probe: 280 refs at the planned positions (both sides) and the scripted copper of the SHRINK-2 spec
note: W2 PCB-PWRA-3 probe for one CI route run (generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/make_probe_spec.py from PWR_A.spec-shrink2.json and placement-study-shrink2.json): every ref the board_gen planner placed is anchored at its planned origin, so that KiCad 10.0.7 checks the placement (courtyards on both sides), the J208 mate against PWR_B J209 and the THT pockets on a saved board, and Freerouting routes it once. Left out (0): refs with a pending planned footprint () and the reserved blocks of pending changes, so the domain and boundary audits fail by construction; removed from pcb/boards/ right after the run.

layers.source: build/15 'Шари' and 'Мідь і струмові класи (W2 PCB-RULES)': JLC04161H-7628, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, no 2 oz

plan.F.Cu: L1: parts, signals; BATT/PWR3A pours (scripted where both ends are anchored)
plan.In1.Cu: L2: solid GND (post-route pour over the whole outline)
plan.In2.Cu: L3: GND fill (pre-route plane) until the placement-dependent power pours take their areas (higher priority)
plan.B.Cu: L4: signals; BATT/PWR3A pours paired with L1; GND bond copper in the four thermal_bond zones, solder mask on

layers.types_why: layer type power on both inner layers and a pre-route GND plane on each (as PWR_B): the DSN then carries the planes and Freerouting puts only vias through them. Probe 2 (sr-rx-pcb run 42424071774) and probe 3 (run 42424538187, layer type alone) routed LAB5, E1_N, E1_SHUNT_P and E1_LAB5_FUSED tracks on In1/In2, which the classes do not count (17 check_boards class_widths findings) and which cut the L2 GND plane. L3 power pours (layer plan) go in later as higher-priority zones inside the L3 GND fill

rules_note: board_gen refuses rules_file until it copies and hashes it (PCB-FAB/PCB-SB1 lineage), so the net classes and project rules of pcb/rules/jlc-4l-1oz.kicad_dru and pcb/generated/netclasses.json are mirrored in PWR_A.kicad_pro: classes SIG (Default) 0.15, PWR1A 0.35, PWR2A 0.8, PWR3A 1.85, BATT 3.2 mm outer, clearance 0.15; via 0.6/0.3; min through hole 0.2 because the KiCad LT3045 footprint MSOP-12-1EP ThermalVias drills 0.2 mm (JLC 4-layer floor 0.15)

power_stages.u107_input_source: TI LM61460 data sheet SNVSBD5D (rev. D, July 2022) section 11.1 Layout Guidelines and figure 11-2 Layout Example, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm61460.pdf read 2026-11-12 (curl default User-Agent, HTTP 200, sha256 2c8a0bf340c70aa3ac29e586146804d7651822e14bee0897f6415ee9e56be84d; fetch-only, not committed)
power_stages.note: W2 PCB-PWRA-3 (design choice; review fixes F1/F2): anchored power stages and their scripted copper. Scripted: E1_SW from J107.2 to Q102; E1_CONV_IN from Q102 to both LM61460 VIN pins (each side with its CIN_HF and CIN, joined by the In2 VIN strap), C107 and both TPSM63606 VIN pins; SYS12 from L102.2 over COUT across the spine to the SYS12 node with F201.1, L202.1 and Q201.2; E1_LAB5_RAW from U108 VOUT to F102.1; E1_LAB5_FUSED from F102.2 to C111.1 and L101.1; LAB5 from L101.2 to C112.1, F104.1, L205.1 (the LT3045 feed) and the four J208 LAB5 contacts (F.Cu and B.Cu trunk). Left to the router (PCB-PWRA-4; placement_study.py corridor pre-check): the U107/U108 small-signal pins (FB, RT, EN, CBOOT, RBOOT, VCC, BIAS, PG) to their parts, the 0603 E1_CONV_IN bypass C132 at U108, the other LAB5 loads (J104, J206.2, U503, U553, C552, C509, C223, R110), E2_LNA_IN from L205.2 to the LT3045 IN pins and every branch net after F201, L202 and Q201

max_height_bottom_note: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR bottom_side h_max (MECH-7: shim gap 0.4 + pocket depth 1.0 - polyimide film 0.07 - clearance 0.3); the heights of the bottom chip parts are not read (TBD per MPN), so check_boards lists them as unverified
tht_pockets_note: proposed plate relief pockets (M-07) = THT pads and NPTH pegs of each placed top part + 1.0 mm (mechanical/params/boards.json tht_pockets margin), rounded outward to 0.05 mm; margin boxes less than 3 mm apart share one pocket (make_probe_spec.py RIB)
